svg.title: System paths, mid level: the steps inside each path
svg.desc: Four columns show each path's steps. Lookup reads one claim row or its scanned form, checks a scan's total against payments, and answers a hidden claim as a missing one. Figures fill a typed query from the semantic layer, check the period against the data, compile SQL through an AST allow-list and run it on the asker's login. Documents read the policy edition in force on the loss date, fuse full-text and vector search, rerank, and cite a chunk for every line. Why fetches both periods, splits the change by driver with a sandbox template, finds a memo or bulletin from within 92 days, and builds its sentences from the rows. The verifier traces figures and citations and checks comparative words. Live mode adds a fast model, a main model, an orchestrator with three tools and a Gemini checker.
svg.text: Verifier, on every sentence of every answer
Live mode, when LLM_BACKEND names a backend
